healing_potion.name: Healing Potion
healing_potion.description: Restore 5 hearts (plus potion healing from items).

greater_healing_potion.name: Greater Healing Potion
greater_healing_potion.description: Restore 9 hearts (plus potion healing from items).

focus_tonic.name: Focus Tonic
focus_tonic.description: Restore 2 of your class resource (Stamina, Mana and so on).

smoke_vial.name: Smoke Vial
smoke_vial.description: Vanish for 5 seconds: enemies lose track of you until you attack.

warding_draught.name: Warding Draught
warding_draught.description: Blocks the next hit you take completely.

haste_potion.name: Potion of Haste
haste_potion.description: Move twice as fast for 6 seconds, and take a second off every cooldown.

fury_potion.name: Potion of Fury
fury_potion.description: Your next attack hits twice as hard.

firebreak_draught.name: Firebreak Draught
firebreak_draught.description: Blocks the next hit you take completely. Brewed for the Farmstead's spreading fires.
